Hockey Player Sreejesh Questions Asian Champions Trophy Squad Selection

Indian hockey player PR Sreejesh has questioned the selection of the squad for the Asian Champions Trophy, stating that young players should be given a real opportunity. The squad announcement for the tournament includes the return of Krishan Pathak.
